comparisons.peer_summary: AMD Solarflare offers low-latency networking solutions using hardware adapters and Onload libraries, serving as the preferred solution for capital markets high-performance applications.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom provide networking solutions, but they target different market segments and technical requirements. Broadcom’s SD-WAN and SASE solutions focus on enterprise-wide network architecture, security, and ubiquitous access (fiber, cellular, satellite) for distributed applications using software-defined networking and AIOps. In contrast, AMD’s Solarflare portfolio provides low-latency hardware adapters and user-space libraries specifically optimized for high-performance capital markets applications. While Broadcom addresses broad enterprise connectivity and security, AMD addresses ultra-low latency needs in financial trading ecosystems.

sentences.text: • SD-WAN and SASE: Our SD-WAN (software-defined wide area network) solution, whether a part of our SASE (secure access service edge) architecture offering or standalone, provides a platform for enterprises to distribute modern applications and advanced AI systems while delivering security and ubiquity of access for distributed applications. Our SD-WAN or SASE solutions bring software-defined networking, security and AIOps together to support ubiquitous access across fiber, cellular and satellite for optimal performance and availability for modern applications.
The AMD Solarflare™ portfolio offers a comprehensive low latency networking solution that combines hardware adapters with the Onload™ family of user space networking libraries.
AMD Solarflare products are the preferred networking solution for capital markets, enabling customers to develop a wide range of high-performance applications across the entire trading ecosystem.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA's data-center-scale offerings comprise compute and networking solutions that can scale to tens of thousands of GPU-accelerated servers functioning as a single giant computer, an architecture necessary for modern AI application development and deployment.
comparisons.comparison: Both companies highlight networking as a critical enabler for advanced computing workloads, but their architectures serve different purposes. Broadcom integrates networking into a SASE architecture that prioritizes security, ubiquitous access (fiber/cellular/satellite), and software-defined management for distributed enterprise applications. NVIDIA focuses on data-center-scale compute and networking interconnects (InfiniBand/Ethernet) designed to scale tens of thousands of GPU-accelerated servers into a single giant computer to support the massive parallel processing required for AI training and inference.

sentences.text: • SD-WAN and SASE: Our SD-WAN (software-defined wide area network) solution, whether a part of our SASE (secure access service edge) architecture offering or standalone, provides a platform for enterprises to distribute modern applications and advanced AI systems while delivering security and ubiquity of access for distributed applications. Our SD-WAN or SASE solutions bring software-defined networking, security and AIOps together to support ubiquitous access across fiber, cellular and satellite for optimal performance and availability for modern applications.

Our data-center-scale offerings are comprised of compute and networking solutions that can scale to tens of thousands of GPU-accelerated servers interconnected to function as a single giant computer; this type of data center architecture and scale is needed for the development and deployment of modern AI applications.
